narr: In the afternoon of the 8th, multiple storms began forming across eastern Colorado. These storms varied in their speed and strength, but overall eastern Colorado experienced baseball sized hail, flash flooding, a tornado, and straight line wind damage with observed speeds of 97 MPH and estimated speeds over 110 MPH. No damage was observed from the tornado.
ev: DOT has closed US 24 between Burlington and Stratton due to flooding. The worst flood waters were east of Bethune.
